subject: Sales discovery follow-up & procurement handoff - FinServe
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today’s call

Hi Mark —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap of what we covered and agreed next steps:

- What you told us: primary use case is customer-facing support automation (avg. 350 tokens/call) and internal knowledge base search. Priority is latency under 150ms P95 for chat and predictable unit cost.
- What Redwood brings: hosted API for POC, option to move to dedicated pools for production throughput, and vendor-friendly billing for enterprise procurement.

Agreed next steps:
1) I’ll share the SOW and pricing range for review (attached).
2) Once you’re ready, Marissa (cc’d) will help with vendor onboarding (W-9, ACH, vendor portal).
3) We’ll schedule a short tech handoff with your engineering or procurement team to confirm SLAs and rollout timeline.

Please confirm: who should Marissa coordinate with on the procurement side (name + email)? If you’d like, we can loop them into a 20-minute vendor setup call next week.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

On Mon, 8 Mar 2027 at 13:05, Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@finserve.com> wrote:
> Great call, Camila. Looking forward to the SOW. I’ll loop in procurement early next week.
>
> —Mark

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Bump — procurement introduction / timing?

Hi Mark —

Just checking in on timing — wanted to make sure this is still a priority and see if there’s anything I can do to expedite the procurement handoff.

If procurement would find it helpful, Marissa can provide the vendor packet (W-9, payment terms, insurance certs) and a short vendor-setup checklist. I’ve attached a quick vendor onboarding note and W-9 for reference.

If the timeline shifted, no worries — just tell me when you’d like us to follow up.

Thanks,
Camila

Attachment: W-9_Redwood.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: FinServe Procurement <procurement@finserve.com>, Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@finserve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement handoff — vendor setup items (W-9, ACH)

Hi Sara / procurement team —

Per Mark’s note, looping you in to start vendor setup for Redwood. Marissa (cc’d) is our finance/vendor-ops lead and will coordinate paperwork. Below are the items we typically need to complete vendor setup:

- Completed W-9 (attached as W-9_Redwood.pdf)
- Company legal name and tax ID (EIN): Redwood Inference, EIN: 12-3456789
- Vendor contact for invoices/payment: payments@redwood.com / Accounts Payable
- Banking details (ACH) — Marissa will provide a secure link if needed for bank info
- Portal invite link: https://finserve.procurehub.com/vendor/Redwood (if you use a vendor portal)
- Signed SOW/DocuSign link (if you need an executed SOW for PO setup): https://redwood.app/docuSign/FS-089

Marissa — can you confirm the secure method you prefer for receiving bank info (DocuSign, secure portal, or email with encrypted attachment)?

If you can confirm vendor record creation and/or send the portal invite, we’ll mark the deal ready to kick off the technical onboarding.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: W-9_Redwood.pdf, vendor-portal-invite.eml

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finserve.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Johnson <mark.johnson@finserve.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement handoff — vendor setup items (W-9, ACH)

Hi Camila / Marissa —

Thanks for the details. We’ve created the vendor record for Redwood Inference and sent a portal invite to payments@redwood.com (should arrive shortly). We also confirmed the EIN provided.

Next steps from our side:
- Payments team will accept the portal invitation and complete bank details via the secure portal.
- Procurement will issue a vendor code and confirm when a PO can be raised (typically 3–5 business days after portal completion).

If you can reply with the contact name that will accept the invite on your side, we’ll flag the record for expedited processing.

Sara Patel
Procurement Manager | FinServe
procurement@finserve.com
